prompt:
A wide 4:1 landscape picture, a side-view effect, the stun loop that circles above the Keeper, a clockwork owl, for a 2D game, painted as four animation stages of one effect that float side by side on open, empty green. Only the effect is painted; whatever it touches or comes from stays off the canvas. The four stages share one horizontal centre line, centred at one eighth, three eighths, five eighths and seven eighths of the picture width, with the same wide band of empty green around each, so every stage sits alone in the open and none comes near another or the picture edge. Everything is drawn in flat side view with no perspective, at the size of a game sprite; the longest stage spans about a fifth of the picture width.

A ring of tumbling stars and tiny gears circles in the air, seen as a flat horizontal ellipse. Every stage shows the same ring: five sharp faceted warm-gold and ivory stars and two small dark bronze gears evenly spaced around it, joined by no orbit line at all, only the stars and gears themselves. The four stages are four phases of one loop: in each, the ring is turned by a quarter of the spacing between neighbours and the stars twinkle (alternating larger cream-cored stars and smaller gold ones), so the ring appears to circle. The ring keeps the same size and centre in all four stages. The palette is warm gold #E9C46A and ivory #FFF5DC for the stars, deep bronze #94611E and dark iron grey-brown #3A3328 for the gears, with a near-black ink edge. Shapes are angular and faceted, cut metal and cut gems.

Style: a dark painterly etched storybook illustration, ink and wash with fine etched cross-hatching and a faint paper grain inside the shapes only. Large shapes have a clean near-black ink outline #171614 about 2 px wide at this size; hair-thin streaks and tiny sparks carry a hairline ink edge so they keep their colour. One light source sits in front and slightly above: upper edges brighter, lower edges shaded with fine hatching. The glow stays inside each shape, brightest at the core and fading toward the ink outline. The background is one perfectly flat, even, pure green #00FF00 from edge to edge, the shapes cut cleanly against it, and the shapes themselves use only the palette above. The canvas holds only the four effects floating on the green, as a clean sprite strip with nothing else on it.
